scripts.licenses:check: node -e 'const { readFileSync } = require("node:fs"); const { join } = require("node:path"); for (const name of ["electron-builder", "electron-updater", "esbuild", "zod"]) { const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join("node_modules", name, "package.json"))); if (typeof pkg.license !== "string" || !pkg.license.trim()) throw new Error(`missing license for ${name}`); }'
